entities.name: Anton Pain Ratu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anton Pain Ratu was an Indonesian Roman Catholic prelate who was auxiliary bishop of Atambua from 1982 to 1984 and bishop of Atambua from 1984 to 2007. Ratu died in Atambua on 6 January 2024, at the age of 95.
